verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a fair question for an accounting SaaS with API, CLI, MCP and webhook channels, so the axis applies. The pack only shows API path versioning and a dated API changelog. Those cover Moneybird's own API surface, not version history, review or rollback of a user's automations, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
